subtitle: Lesson 15 · Workbooks & Visualization

code:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize FailedCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
caption: render doesn't filter or aggregate -- it's a display instruction appended after the real work is done.

eyebrow: Three render types, three column shapes
code:
| render timechart   -- time column + numeric column, plotted over time
| render piechart    -- category + numeric column, shown as proportions
| render barchart    -- category + numeric column, shown as bars
caption: The chart is only as good as the summarize step that fed it.
